mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_coupon_template WHERE region=#{region} AND is_deleted=FALSE AND status=1 AND (claim_start IS NULL OR claim_start <= #{now}) AND (claim_end IS NULL OR claim_end >= #{now}) ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT FROM marketing_coupon_template WHERE id=#{id} AND region=#{region} AND is_deleted=FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_coupon_template SET name=#{name},type=#{type},threshold_amount=#{thresholdAmount},discount_amount=#{discountAmount}, currency=#{currency},shop_id=#{shopId},total_quantity=#{totalQuantity},per_user_limit=#{perUserLimit}, valid_days=#{validDays},claim_start=#{claimStart},claim_end=#{claimEnd},status=#{status}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND region=#{region} AND is_deleted=FALSE

UPDATE marketing_coupon_template SET claimed_quantity=claimed_quantity+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=FALSE AND status=1 AND (total_quantity=0 OR claimed_quantity < total_quantity)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_coupon WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND template_id=#{templateId}

SELECT FROM user_coupon uc LEFT JOIN marketing_coupon_template t ON t.id=uc.template_id WHERE uc.user_id=#{userId} AND uc.region=#{region} AND uc.status=1 AND (uc.expire_at IS NULL OR uc.expire_at >= #{now}) AND uc.threshold_amount <= #{amount} AND (uc.shop_id=0 OR uc.shop_id=#{shopId}) ORDER BY uc.discount_amount DESC, uc.expire_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_coupon SET status=2,used_at=#{usedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status=1
UPDATE user_coupon SET used_order_id=#{orderId} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE user_coupon SET status=1,used_order_id=NULL,used_at=NULL WHERE used_order_id=#{orderId} AND status=2
UPDATE user_coupon SET status=3 WHERE status=1 AND expire_at IS NOT NULL AND expire_at < #{now}
